items.title: Ackman Bets $1 Billion on Netflix Redemption After $400 Million 2022 Loss
items.summary: Bill Ackman lost $400 million the last time he bought Netflix and bailed within three months. Now Pershing Square just disclosed a $1 billion position, and the reasons he walked away in 2022 look nothing like the streaming landscape he is walking back into.

items.title: Price Prediction: One Bank Sees Netflix at $57. We See Triple That.
items.summary: One major bank just slapped a brutally low price target on Netflix even as the company reports double-digit revenue growth and a $25 billion buyback. The gap between the most bearish Wall Street call and our proprietary model is too wide to ignore.

items.title: Could You Have Seen Warner Bros Discovery Stock's Run Coming?
items.summary: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD) stock gained about 55% from mid-September 2025 to mid-September 2026, while Disney, Netflix and Comcast all fell and the S&P 500 returned 17.3% including dividends. By August 2026 the company was under an agreed sale to Paramount Skydance. The buyer and the timing were never visible in advance. An openness to restructuring was, and management spent 2025 rebuilding the company to keep its options open.

items.title: Welcome to Climate Week NYC; Plus, the Silver Lining to a Surge in Borrowing Costs
items.summary: Welcome to Climate Week NYC, which is being held this year alongside the United Nations General Assembly.  This year, our Journal House UNGA will kick off conversations with global leaders and corporate executives to talk about various topics including energy, climate and resource security; economic security and global markets; AI, technology and the future of resilience; and geopolitical risk.  Inflation is sure to be a topic of discussion this week and ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.
